Maria: Heads up — platform + runtime sync: we need to finalize the schema and ownership for continuous-batching / queueing metrics so Console dashboards and alerts are usable. cc @Aj @Ryan @Sara @Anil

Aj: Can you list the specific signals you want surfaced? trying to keep series count sane.

Ryan: From runtime POV: minimal set = batch_size distribution (histogram), batch_wait_time (histogram), batch_fill_rate (gauge), queue_length (gauge), in_flight_tokens (gauge), and saturation_ratio (gauge). labels: model, region, instance_type, pool.

Sara: + per-route tag is critical for debugging rollouts (route or route_id). but that explodes cardinality if we include customer_route for every route.

Anil: agree. propose: include route for top N routes (by QPS) and otherwise tag as `route=other`. also limit instance_type cardinality to top 10 cloud SKUs.

Aj: For histograms we need specific buckets. propose batch_size buckets: [1,2,4,8,16,32,64]. wait_time buckets in ms: [0.5,1,2,5,10,25,50,100,250,500,1000]. sound reasonable?

Ryan: those look good. runtime will emit Prometheus-style histogram metrics: `redwood_batcher_batch_size_bucket`, `redwood_batcher_batch_size_sum`, `redwood_batcher_batch_size_count`. same for `batch_wait_time` with ms unit.

Maria: We also want a derived 95th percentile for dashboards. example PromQL: 
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_batcher_batch_size_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, region))
```
Use 5m for realtime panels, 1h for trend panels.

Sara: For saturation, we need to define formula. Ops wants a single % number per pool. proposal: saturation_ratio = queued_tokens / (queued_tokens + processed_tokens) over 1m. we can surface as `redwood_batcher_saturation_ratio` (gauge).

Anil: +1 but queued_tokens and processed_tokens need well-defined sources. runtime: can you export counters `redwood_batcher_queued_tokens_total` and `redwood_batcher_processed_tokens_total`?

Ryan: yes. we'll emit counters and a gauge for the computed ratio as convenient. counters will have labels (model, pool, region).

Aj: Important: storage / series cost. We need a cardinality cap policy. suggestion: allow labels [model, region, pool, tier], but route only for top 200 routes. any low-volume route should be collapsed to `route=other`. runtime should sample route label when route cardinality >200.

Maria: Agreed. Also add `rollout_tag` label for canary vs stable (values: canary, stable) — small cardinality and useful for Console rollouts UX.

Sara: Dashboards: panels we need: batch size histogram, batch wait p50/p95, fill_rate trend, saturation heatmap (pool x region), queue length timeseries, top-k slow routes. I'll sketch layout in Grafana after we get the exact metric names.

Aj: For ingestion, telemetry team: can we enforce sample rate on high-cardinality labels? ops-bot, any quota implications?

ops-bot: ALERT: high-cardinality metrics may increase TSDB storage by ~3-5x based on current sampling. Please file a telemetry-plan ticket with expected series counts and retention.

Anil: I'll run a quick sample of current route cardinality and send numbers. we should set 7d retention for histograms, 30d for aggregates, 90d for rollups? thoughts?

Maria: Minimum: 14d for raw histograms to diagnose regressions, 90d for downsampled rollups. I'll put retention proposal in the ticket.

Ryan: runtime action items: emit metrics with agreed names and buckets, implement route-top-N collapse, add `rollout_tag` label, and expose counters for queued/processed tokens. ETA: next deploy (2 weeks) unless we need gated rollout.

Aj: platform action items: prepare dashboard scaffolding, add alert recipes (p95 wait > 500ms for 5m, saturation_ratio > 0.7 for >3m), and coordinate telemetry ticket for quotas.

Sara: I'll own dashboard layout and alert wording. Maria, can you own prioritizing routes list for top-N?

Maria: Yes. I'll share top-N list by EOD tomorrow.

Ryan: I'll open PR with emitted metric names + example PromQL snippets and link here when ready.

Aj: Thanks all — I'll open the telemetry-plan ticket and tag runtime + platform.

Maria: Thanks. quick ask: when you emit histograms, include unit in metric help string (ms / tokens) and consistent `_total`/`_sum` naming. small things save us later. :+1:

ops-bot: NOTE: telemetry-plan ticket created: TELE-4321. Assigned: Aj, Ryan, Sara.

Sara: cool — will sync with Aj tomorrow 9:30am PT.

Maria: closing loop here. anyone else? otherwise will mark owners and action items in the ticket.

Aj: all good from infra side.

Anil: good to go from SRE.

Ryan: thumbs up. rolling into next sprint.

Maria: thanks everyone :rocket:
